lines.reference: Bananas, raw — USDA FDC 173944: 89 kcal / 100 g
Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry — USDA FDC 173904: 379 kcal / 100 g
Raisins, dark, seedless — USDA FDC 168165: 299 kcal / 100 g
Spices, cinnamon, ground — USDA FDC 171320: 247 kcal / 100 g

notes: Assumptions: 2 medium bananas ~118 g peeled each; 1 cup rolled oats ~85 g; ¼ cup raisins ~38 g. 16 bites. Sanity check: SparkPeople 3-ingredient oatmeal banana raisin cookie bites 42.6 kcal each (24 from a larger batch); Baylor College of Medicine banana raisin oatmeal cookie 35 kcal; ours (40) matches.
